summary: Passaporto sanitario E2E (backend + frontend). Backend: 19/19 pytest pass (new test_health_passport.py 18 + test_passport_autopublish.py 1): payload, consent 412/400, share create/list/revoke, public info + X-Robots-Tag, wrong code 'Tentativi rimasti', summary vs full scoping, no CF in payload, PDF (403 on summary, 404 on hidden, 410 after revoke), hide/unhide, access log (apertura/referto_pdf/importazione + mantmed_doctor flag), import rules (401 anon, 403 allow_import=false, created:true then created:false, no duplicate in cardio folder), vaccinations 409/400/delete/cross-tenant 404, field_meta on PATCH, sign auto-publish with passport_consent_at, robots.txt. Frontend: all requested flows work in UI (menu, red allergy box, chronic, therapies, blood group with 'Inserito da Dott.ssa Tiziana Foti · data', vaccines done/next, 3 growth tabs with '(OMS)' rows, visits with Referto PDF/Nascondi/Mostra, bilanci next, consent step with mandatory checkbox, options, QR+link+6-digit code, two-step revoke, shared page unlock/error/gone, noindex meta, no CF in DOM, promo for anonymous with /registrati/medico, import button for MantMed doctor, not-allowed message, emergency 1080x1920 PNG preview + download, doctor vaccines editor, PatientDialog new fields). ONE HIGH BUG found: after 'Importa nella cartella' the parent's passport shows every item DUPLICATED (allergies, chronic, vaccinations 13->26, measurements 12->24, doctors list gains the importing doctor) — also visible on shared pages and on the emergency card.

critical.issue: Imported patient copies guardian_email (+cf_hash), so registration.link_children auto-links the parent to the new cardiologist folder at next portal load. assemble() then merges both folders WITHOUT dedup: allergies/chronic/therapies shown twice ('Inserito da Passaporto condiviso dal genitore (importato da Dott. Marco Bianchi)'), vaccinations duplicated (same code+dose), measurements duplicated and re-attributed to the importing doctor as '(inserita in studio)', header shows 'Dott. Marco Bianchi, Dott.ssa Tiziana Foti'. Propagates to every new share and to the emergency card PNG (allergy/patologia printed twice). Reproduced via UI and API.

minor.issue: Per-IP limit (20/10min) counts successful opens too; in testing it triggered 'Troppi tentativi' before the 5-wrong-code lockout could be observed. Consider counting only failed attempts.

Measurement dedup only uses dates already in target folder; source duplicates on the same date (demo has 5x 18kg on 2026-10-21) are all copied. Import also has no role check beyond the api router (fine if router enforces doctor).

Next bilancio = first BILANCI entry with upper bound > age and not done; for Aurora (4a2m) demo has '5-6 anni' already done so next shown is '8-10 anni' (data-driven, but logic skips any earlier due bilancio check by date).

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicated allergies/patologie/vaccines rendered after an import (consequence of backend bug above)

issues: Native <select> and native <input type=date> (browser default picker) instead of shadcn Select/Calendar
vaccine-delete-<id> deletes immediately without confirmation (revoke has two-step, delete does not)
'nata/o' shown even though sex is known (F)
Doctor-side 'Condivisioni attive del genitore: Nessuna condivisione attiva' while parent had 3 active passport shares — label may confuse (it lists network shares, not passport shares)

action_items: HIGH: dedupe in assemble(): summary values by normalized text (keep first/original author), vaccinations by (code,dose), measurements by (date,weight,height,hc); keep original 'by' for imported data; OR do not copy guardian_email on import / do not auto-link folders created via passport-import (created_from='passaporto') — decide product rule, but parent passport and emergency card must not show duplicates
Consider counting only failed code attempts in the per-IP rate limit for /open
Optional: confirm step for vaccine delete; use shadcn Select/Calendar in VaccinesEditor/PatientDialog if allowed by 'non cambiare' constraint

rca of the issue: Import creates patient in doctor's folder with same cf_hash and guardian_email=genitore email -> registration.link_children (runs on parent session) adds it to users.children -> group_of() returns both folders -> assemble() appends items from each folder without dedup. Mitigation: dedup in assemble and/or skip auto-link for created_from passport import.
